name: DYAMOND ICON Summer and Winter coarse-grained cloud cover dataset
resolution: Coarse-grained from 2.5 km / 58 vertical levels to ~80 km / 27 vertical levels
access: https://github.com/EyringMLClimateGroup/grundner23james_EquationDiscovery_CloudCover/tree/main and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8220333; full DYAMOND data on DKRZ HPC via https://www.esiwace.eu/services/dyamond-initiative

scales.note: DYAMOND ICON coarse-grained from 2.5 km to 80 km; total span comprises 61 days across Summer 2016 and Winter 2020 periods; several TB estimated as ~3000 GB.
